entries.description: Placeholder avatar: auburn hair mass, pale oval, ringed yellow eyes.
Neutral: level ringed eyes, flat mouth. The default face.
Smile: eyes narrowed a touch, a small upward curve. Approval.
Stare: larger eyes with more rings, no mouth. When the user hesitates.
Displeased: half-lidded eyes, slight downward curve, cooler tint. Rare.
Red-tinted city dusk with a low sun; for control scenes and calling in promises.
A dim office with blinds and evening light; for working hours.
Thin yellow rings on near-black with a red vignette; for late, quiet talk.
64x64 game tile: one flat colour with a white shape.
Low two-tone chime, under a second; play once before a request.
A soft click; a small acknowledgement.
Two-second slow ring pulse, 256x256; decorative, e.g. behind windows at low opacity.
